aggregates.description: Authoritative registry of every carrier_license this regulator has touched: pending applications under review, active licenses currently in force, suspended licenses awaiting reinstatement or revocation, denied applications, and revoked licenses. The single source of truth for the regulator's TEL-backed licensing posture.

license_granted.value: { "license_said": event.license_said, "license_number": event.license_number, "holder_aid": event.holder_aid, "jurisdiction": event.jurisdiction, "lines_of_business": event.lines_of_business, "effective_date": event.effective_date, "expiration_date": event.expiration_date, "granted_at": event.granted_at }

license_reinstated.expression: { "pending_applications": state.pending_applications, "denied_applications": state.denied_applications, "suspended_licenses": state.suspended_licenses.filter(l, l.license_said != event.license_said), "active_licenses": state.active_licenses + state.suspended_licenses.filter(l, l.license_said == event.license_said).map(l, { "license_said": l.license_said, "license_number": l.license_number, "holder_aid": l.holder_aid, "jurisdiction": l.jurisdiction, "lines_of_business": l.lines_of_business, "effective_date": l.effective_date, "expiration_date": l.expiration_date, "granted_at": l.granted_at }), "revoked_licenses": state.revoked_licenses }

license_revoked.expression: { "pending_applications": state.pending_applications, "denied_applications": state.denied_applications, "active_licenses": state.active_licenses.filter(l, l.license_said != event.license_said), "suspended_licenses": state.suspended_licenses.filter(l, l.license_said != event.license_said), "revoked_licenses": state.revoked_licenses + state.active_licenses.filter(l, l.license_said == event.license_said).map(l, { "license_said": l.license_said, "license_number": l.license_number, "holder_aid": l.holder_aid, "jurisdiction": l.jurisdiction, "lines_of_business": l.lines_of_business, "effective_date": l.effective_date, "expiration_date": l.expiration_date, "granted_at": l.granted_at, "revocation_reason": event.revocation_reason, "revoked_at": event.revoked_at }) + state.suspended_licenses.filter(l, l.license_said == event.license_said).map(l, { "license_said": l.license_said, "license_number": l.license_number, "holder_aid": l.holder_aid, "jurisdiction": l.jurisdiction, "lines_of_business": l.lines_of_business, "effective_date": l.effective_date, "expiration_date": l.expiration_date, "granted_at": l.granted_at, "revocation_reason": event.revocation_reason, "revoked_at": event.revoked_at }) }

license_suspended.expression: { "pending_applications": state.pending_applications, "denied_applications": state.denied_applications, "active_licenses": state.active_licenses.filter(l, l.license_said != event.license_said), "suspended_licenses": state.suspended_licenses + state.active_licenses.filter(l, l.license_said == event.license_said).map(l, { "license_said": l.license_said, "license_number": l.license_number, "holder_aid": l.holder_aid, "jurisdiction": l.jurisdiction, "lines_of_business": l.lines_of_business, "effective_date": l.effective_date, "expiration_date": l.expiration_date, "granted_at": l.granted_at, "suspension_reason": event.suspension_reason, "suspended_at": event.suspended_at }), "revoked_licenses": state.revoked_licenses }

test_vectors.name: application received then granted results in an active license and no pending application
license suspended then revoked ends up in revoked_licenses with full fields retained

commands.description: Adjudicate a pending application favorably and issue a new carrier_license credential to the applicant. Locksmith renders this as the regulator's grant-decision form, prefilled from the inbound application.

emissions.payload_mapping: { "license_said": credential.said, "holder_aid": command.holder_aid, "license_number": command.license_number, "jurisdiction": command.jurisdiction, "lines_of_business": command.lines_of_business, "effective_date": command.effective_date, "expiration_date": command.expiration_date, "application_id": command.application_id, "granted_at": command.granted_at }

commands.name: Grant carrier license

application_id.description: SAID of the carrier_license_application this grant adjudicates.

granted_at.description: Regulator-stated date/time the grant takes administrative effect. Client-supplied (mirrors effective_date/expiration_date): the command's {command, state} binding has no runtime clock, so this cannot be sourced from an event envelope that doesn't exist yet at emission time.

holder_aid.description: AID of the carrier receiving this licence — the applicant on the application being adjudicated. Client-supplied for the same reason granted_at is: the command's {command, state} binding has no accessor for the counterparty's AID, and the regulator already holds it from the inbound application.

commands.description: Adjudicate a pending application unfavorably. Sends a spurn back to the applicant and records the denial in the license registry. No credential is issued.
commands.name: Deny carrier license application

denial_reason.description: Plain-English reason for the denial. Surfaced to the applicant.

denied_at.description: Regulator-stated date/time of the denial. Client-supplied: the command's {command, state} binding has no runtime clock.

commands.description: Temporarily put an active carrier_license into a suspended state. The license is not revoked; the carrier may seek reinstatement once grounds are cleared.
commands.name: Suspend carrier license

suspended_at.description: Regulator-stated date/time the suspension takes effect. Client-supplied: the command's {command, state} binding has no runtime clock.

commands.description: Move a suspended carrier_license back to active. Requires the suspension_grounds_cleared rule to evaluate true.
commands.name: Reinstate suspended license

commands.description: Permanently invalidate a carrier_license. Fires a TEL revocation event; the credential cannot be reinstated after revocation.
commands.name: Revoke carrier license

revoked_at.description: Regulator-stated date/time the revocation takes effect. Client-supplied: the command's {command, state} binding has no runtime clock.

exports.description: Authorization for a carrier to bear insurance risk on the listed lines of business in this jurisdiction. Issued by the state DOI to a regulated insurance carrier; verifiable by any party that needs to confirm the carrier is in good standing.
exports.name: Carrier License

imports.narrative: The self-issued application ACDC a carrier presents via IPEX grant. Received, validated, and adjudicated; the granted carrier_license edges back to its SAID.

header.description: The state Department of Insurance's side of carrier licensing: receive applications, adjudicate them, grant or spurn the license credential, and manage its full lifecycle (suspension, reinstatement, revocation). Pivotal event: a license has been granted or revoked.

projections.description: License applications awaiting regulatory review. Sorted by receipt time so the oldest applications surface first.
projections.name: Pending Applications

display.empty_state: No active licenses in this jurisdiction.

granting then revoking a license leaves no row behind

reactions.description: When a carrier presents a carrier_license_application ACDC via IPEX grant, record the application in the license registry as pending and surface it to the regulator's review queue. The regulator will then either grant_license or spurn_application.

When a carrier withdraws a pending application (notification to /insurance/note/application_withdrawn) before adjudication, remove it from pending_applications. No spurn fires because the applicant is the one cancelling.

role.description: A US state's insurance regulator. The DOI is the root authority for carrier licensing within its jurisdiction: its commands are gated by KEL-anchored regulatory authority rather than by held credentials. The DOI issues, suspends, reinstates, and revokes carrier_license credentials.

rules.body: The undersigned State Department of Insurance, acting under the statutory authority of its enabling jurisdiction, holds exclusive power to license entities authorized to bear insurance risk within that jurisdiction. The CarrierLicense credential, when issued by this regulator's KEL-anchored AID, constitutes prima facie evidence of the licensee's authority to underwrite the listed lines of business between the effective_date and expiration_date stated therein. Licensees acknowledge and accept that this license is held subject to ongoing compliance with the regulatory framework of the granting jurisdiction and may be suspended or revoked by the regulator for cause.
rules.title: Authority to License Insurance Carriers

rules.body: Holders of a CarrierLicense agree to maintain continuous compliance with the licensing terms of the granting jurisdiction. Licensees shall: (a) maintain actuarially-certified solvency reserves at or above the regulatory minimum; (b) submit annual statutory filings within ninety (90) days of fiscal year end; (c) notify the regulator within ten (10) business days of any material adverse change to financial condition, ownership, or operational footprint; and (d) cooperate fully with any market-conduct examination conducted by the regulator. Failure to maintain compliance is grounds for suspension or revocation of the license under this regulator's enforcement powers.
rules.title: Ongoing Compliance Obligation

rules.description: The carrier's application contains all fields required for license issuance: the command payload (sourced from the application) contains application_id, license_number candidate, jurisdiction, lines_of_business with at least one item, effective_date, and expiration_date.
rules.expression: notNull(command.application_id) && notNull(command.license_number) && notNull(command.jurisdiction) && size(command.lines_of_business) >= 1 && notNull(command.effective_date) && notNull(command.expiration_date)
rules.title: Application complete

rules.description: Gates grant_license and spurn_application on the named application_id still being in pending_applications.
rules.title: Application is pending and not yet adjudicated

rules.description: Gates suspend_license on the named license_said being in active_licenses.
rules.title: License is currently active

rules.description: Gates reinstate_license on the named license_said being in suspended_licenses.
rules.title: License is currently suspended

rules.description: Gates revoke_license on the named license_said being either active or suspended (already-revoked licenses cannot be re-revoked).
rules.expression: state.active_licenses.exists(l, l.license_said == command.license_said) || state.suspended_licenses.exists(l, l.license_said == command.license_said)
rules.title: License is currently active or suspended

rules.description: Required for the activate transition (pending -> active). Confirms the applicant has demonstrated solvency reserves at or above the regulatory minimum. The credential carries a market_conduct_status attribute set by the regulator's review process; in practice this is gated by the regulator's signature on grant_license.
rules.title: Financial solvency demonstrated for activation

rules.description: Required for the reinstate transition (suspended -> active). Captures the regulator's determination that the conditions causing suspension have been remediated. The regulator's manual approval of reinstate_license is the operational gate; this predicate is the formal articulation.
rules.title: Suspension grounds have been cleared

rules.description: Aggregate invariant: a carrier cannot hold multiple simultaneously active licenses for the same jurisdiction issued by this regulator. Groups active_licenses by holder_aid + jurisdiction and asserts cardinality <= 1.
rules.expression: state.active_licenses.all(l, size(state.active_licenses.filter(o, o.holder_aid == l.holder_aid && o.jurisdiction == l.jurisdiction)) == 1)
rules.title: At most one active license per carrier in this jurisdiction

rules.description: The legal_prose Authority to License Insurance Carriers is articulated formally by the financial_solvency_demonstrated predicate gating the activate transition, and protected at the aggregate level by no_duplicate_active_license_per_carrier.
rules.title: Authority articulation

workflows.description: Regulator's view of the licensing conversation. Triggered when a carrier presents a carrier_license_application ACDC via IPEX grant. Records the application as pending, branches on the regulator's internal review decision, and emits either a grant (issuing the carrier_license credential) or a spurn (denial with reason).
workflows.name: License Grant Workflow

steps.name: Await carrier admit (or spurn) of granted credential
Carrier did not admit grant in time

workflows.description: Regulator-initiated revocation of an active or suspended license following a compliance violation. Fires the TEL revocation event; the carrier observes the revocation via their watcher network.
workflows.name: License Revocation Workflow

workflows.description: Regulator-initiated suspension of an active license for a stated reason. The suspension is reversible via reinstate_license once suspension_grounds_cleared.
workflows.name: License Suspension Workflow
